faqs.question: What is LEDi used for?
faqs.answer: It's an LED illumination system built for photochemistry, photocatalysis, photoredox chemistry, photobiology, and related light-driven experiments on small samples.

faqs.question: How much faster does LEDi make a reaction?
faqs.answer: A published 2018 study found it drove a Sonogashira coupling 10 times faster than a conventional LED setup.

faqs.question: How do I reproduce an exact illumination condition?
faqs.answer: Note the reading on the current indicator during the first run, then match that same reading on future runs to reproduce the exact light intensity.

faqs.question: How do I switch between sample formats?
faqs.answer: Swap the holder. The standard cuvette holder installs directly, and tube, vial, or NMR-tube holders drop in when the sample format changes.

faqs.question: Does LEDi mix the sample during illumination?
faqs.answer: Yes, an integrated variable-speed magnetic mixer runs continuously below the sample holder throughout the exposure.

faqs.question: What wavelengths does LEDi cover?
faqs.answer: The standard RGB head covers blue, green, red, and white. Optional heads extend coverage into UV and near-infrared for specific applications.

faqs.question: How does LEDi keep the sample from overheating during illumination?
faqs.answer: The LEDs run air-cooled, keeping sample heating to a minimum while illumination stays stable.

faqs.question: What safety equipment comes with LEDi?
faqs.answer: A protective shield to reduce stray light exposure, plus LED safety glasses for the operator.

faqs.question: What is the price of LEDi in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote around your head and holder configuration.

sections.title: Sample Handling, Mixing, and Reproducibility
sections.tabSummary: Holders, stirring, and the current indicator
body: Getting consistent photochemistry results depends on three things staying constant: how the sample mixes, how much light actually reaches it, and how easily both can be repeated.

The magnetic mixer runs the whole time a sample is under illumination, not just before or after, keeping concentration even throughout the reaction. Sample format flexibility comes from swappable holders, starting with the standard cuvette holder and moving to tube, vial, or NMR-tube holders as the work calls for it. And because the current indicator shows exactly how much power is reaching the LEDs, one reading noted today reproduces the exact same condition weeks later.

heroParagraphs: A photochemistry reaction is only as reproducible as your light source, and most LED setups give you no real way to prove what you delivered. LEDi solves both problems at once.

Seven high-power LEDs across four independently controlled color banks, blue, green, red, and white, focus down to a spot roughly half an inch across, small enough for a cuvette or tube and precise enough that specialized lenses do the concentrating for you. A current indicator tracks exactly how much power reached your sample, so you can dial in a condition once and reproduce it exactly on your next run.

An integrated magnetic mixer keeps your sample stirring continuously through the whole exposure, air cooling keeps the LEDs from adding unwanted heat to your reaction, and the head slides along an adjustable rail so you can fine-tune distance from the sample yourself.
